RoboDojo.method: Success-only. Six Pi_05 tasks with >=2 official successes each; retain the previously downloaded successful pour_liquid_into_cup episode and supplement it from another model; randomly sample three more distinct eligible base tasks and two successes from one eligible model per task.

LIBERO.method: Uniform random 3 task files from 130 official task files; 2 distinct random demos per task. All three sampled tasks belong to LIBERO-90.

RoboTwin.method: Uniform random 3 demo_clean task archives from the official dataset; 2 distinct random episodes per task.
